_meta.description: Module stack lifecycle data — language/runtime EOL for module floor health evaluation
_meta.purpose: Used by the modules posture pillar to evaluate floor health of module runtime constraints. Separate from tool_lifecycle.json which serves the toolchain pillar.

python.notes: Python releases a new minor annually. Each minor supported ~5 years. 3.9 EOL Oct 2025. 3.10 EOL Oct 2026. 3.11 EOL Oct 2027. 3.12 EOL Oct 2028. 3.13 EOL Oct 2029.

node.notes: Even-numbered releases are LTS (~30 months). Odd-numbered are current (~6 months). Node 18 LTS ends Apr 2025. Node 20 LTS ends Apr 2026. Node 22 LTS ends Apr 2027.

go.notes: Go supports the two most recent minor releases. New minor every ~6 months. go.mod go directive declares the minimum Go version required.

rust.notes: Rust releases every 6 weeks. Only the latest release is officially supported. rust-version in Cargo.toml declares MSRV (minimum supported Rust version). No formal EOL — older versions just miss features and fixes.

ruby.notes: Ruby supports ~3 most recent minor releases. New minor annually. 3.1 EOL Mar 2025. 3.2 EOL Mar 2026.

java.notes: Java has LTS releases (8, 11, 17, 21) and short-term releases (6 months). LTS gets extended support. Java 17 LTS until Sep 2029. Java 21 LTS until Sep 2031.

php.notes: PHP releases annually. Each version gets 2 years active + 1 year security-only. 8.1 security-only ends Dec 2025.

elixir.notes: Elixir supports the latest 3 minor releases. Tied to Erlang/OTP compatibility.
